skills.summary: Build a REST endpoint end to end
skills.job: Add one endpoint with validation, handler, errors and tests that match the codebase.
gotchas: skipping input validation at the boundary
business logic inside the route handler
status codes that disagree with the body

skills.summary: Write or fix an OpenAPI spec
skills.job: Produce an accurate OpenAPI document from code or a design and validate it.
gotchas: reusing one schema for request and response

skills.job: Define one error shape and map failures to status codes and messages.
triggers: what status code should this return
gotchas: messages clients must parse as strings

skills.job: Pick offset, page or cursor pagination for an endpoint and implement it safely.
gotchas: offset skipping rows on concurrent inserts

skills.job: Review login, session, token and password flows for real weaknesses.
gotchas: tokens stored where scripts can read them

skills.summary: Add rate limiting to an API
skills.job: Choose limits, keys and storage for rate limiting and implement them with correct responses.
gotchas: limiting by IP behind a proxy
per-process counters in a multi-instance deploy

skills.summary: Make API writes safe to retry
skills.job: Add idempotency to write endpoints so retries do not duplicate effects.
triggers: handle double submit on the server
gotchas: key stored after the side effect
same key with a different body accepted

skills.summary: Move slow work into background jobs
skills.job: Identify work that should leave the request path and design the job with retries and status.
triggers: move this to a background job
gotchas: jobs that are not safe to run twice
passing big payloads instead of ids

skills.job: Decide what to cache, where, for how long and how it gets invalidated.
gotchas: caching per-user data under a shared key

skills.summary: Read a query plan and fix the slow part
skills.job: Interpret EXPLAIN output and name the step that makes a query slow.
gotchas: tiny dev data hiding the problem

skills.job: Choose indexes from real query patterns and weigh their write cost.
Model entities, keys, constraints and relations for a feature.
triggers: how should I model this data
gotchas: storing lists in one text column
wrong type for money and time

skills.job: Detect N+1 query patterns from an ORM and replace them with joins or batching.
gotchas: counting queries only in tests with tiny data
lazy access hidden in templates or serializers

skills.job: Decide what must be atomic and keep transactions short and correct.
triggers: do I need a transaction here

skills.job: Build a webhook receiver that verifies, acknowledges fast and processes once.
gotchas: verifying a parsed body instead of the raw bytes

skills.job: Check a GraphQL schema for naming, nullability, pagination and resolver cost.
gotchas: no query depth or cost limits

skills.job: Implement uploads with size limits, type checks, safe storage and streaming.
Structure how an app reads config and secrets, validates them at startup and keeps them out of code.
triggers: how should I handle env variables
gotchas: secrets with defaults that work in production
config read lazily and failing late

skills.job: Design message consumers with acknowledgement, retries, ordering and dead letters.
triggers: what to do with failed messages
